name: Cold waves & winter storms
summary: No top-tier cold or winter-storm warning across a major region on 22 Nov; US forecasters see Thanksgiving snow risk
state: US forecasts on 19 Nov pointed to possible snow around Thanksgiving on 26 Nov in the interior Northeast and Intermountain West, and NOAA's Climate Prediction Center gave a slight risk of heavy snow in the Cascades and northern Rockies late in the month; these were outlooks, not warnings (Gizmodo). Northern China's cold wave eased by 19 Nov. Searches on 22 Nov found no top-tier cold or winter-storm warning across a major region and no cold-related power or gas outages, so Normal holds.
for_you: Travellers in the US around 26 Nov may face snow in the Northeast and western mountains. Follow National Weather Service and Met Office warnings as winter weather develops.
rubric_hit: No top-tier cold or winter-storm warnings across a major region = Normal

sources.title: Gizmodo — Forecasts increasingly call for a snowy Thanksgiving despite El Niño

why: Severe cold and winter storms kill, cut power and spike gas demand, as in Texas in 2021; they matter most when energy supplies are tight.
drivers: Polar vortex disruption, blocking highs, ENSO, Arctic outbreaks.

rubric.alert: Deadly cold or winter storms with widespread power or gas outages.
rubric.watch: Top-tier cold or winter-storm warnings across a major region, or a cold wave lifting gas demand sharply.
rubric.normal: No major cold wave or winter storm affecting large populations.
